    77	## Scope limits
    78	
    79	The Collatz rows describe analytic/CF kernels and conditional assemblies,
    80	not a completed specialization to log₂3 or Collatz dynamics. Positive-natural
    81	covering is now proved for the stated mod-7 and 5/7 families. The QR count has
    82	a proved CRT interpretation for its explicitly defined target set; externally
    83	filtered frontiers and cubic-family exclusions remain separate. Descent and
    84	q-adic results still require the stated QQ/M23/R74 inputs where used. The
    85	barrier is a CRT escape kernel with supplied local obstructions; the integer
    86	polynomial Schinzel–Mordell implication remains unformalized. Global graph
    87	extremality now implies the score ceiling through exact edge accounting.
    88
